layouts.name: ArenaClass
layouts.description: Header-resident immutable descriptor; offsets are absolute within bank resource.

layouts.name: ResourceHeader
layouts.description: Immutable after resource activation. Hash covers all 4096 bytes with descriptor_hash zeroed.

layouts.name: ProducerPage
layouts.description: Only registered producer writes; remaining bytes permanently zero.

layouts.name: CursorPage
layouts.description: One distinct memfd and registered writer for every reader/bank pair; borrow count is diagnostic only.

layouts.name: DepthCoverage
layouts.description: Versioned exact side coverage; absent prices are known zero only inside that side boundary.

layouts.name: HandoverReadyBody
layouts.description: Qualified strategy callback completion plus durable checkpoint/input seal; host validates actual report cursor and immutable objects.

layouts.name: RestoreAppliedBody
layouts.description: Qualified process completed actual restore or rollback probe, synchronized output and canonical receipt; receiver verifies Registry identity and complete release binding.

layouts.name: CheckpointSealBody
layouts.description: Fresh checkpoint challenge. Mode 0 captures the exact requested report position; mode 1 also pauses future callbacks. Mode 2 observes a current position at least as large as the requested lower bound without pausing input processing. An expired mode 2 query is discarded without stopping the worker. Only an explicitly approved SDK build supporting the selected mode may receive it.

layouts.name: CheckpointSealReplyBody
layouts.description: Challenge-bound checkpoint response. report_sequence always echoes the requested position; ready.exec_report_sequence equals it for modes 0/1 and is at least it for mode 2. The actual READY and durable closure must be checked against the execution owner report prefix and mapped cursor. A prior READY never answers a new challenge.

validation_rules: Every byte is covered by exactly one field, including explicit reserved fields.
Scalar fields are naturally aligned; atomic_u64 fields are aligned to 128 bytes in their owning page.
Integer bounds and checked additions/multiplications are mandatory before indexing.
Unknown enums, flags, opcodes and nonzero reserved bytes are rejected in ABI 1.0.
All body bytes not used by the selected message are zero.

Resource size is exact. MarketBank/IntentBank/ReportBank capacity is a power of two from 64 through 1048576; Cursor capacity and record_bytes are zero; snapshot/catalog/manifest capacity equals validated SnapshotHeader.entry_count and need not be a power of two; ConfigProjection uses record_bytes=1 and capacity=exact raw projection byte length.
No uint64 sequence may reach 2^63; rotate feed/channel before exhaustion.
For slot sequence s and first_seq F: index=(s-F)&(capacity-1).
Payload arena block is immutable from publication until every registered holder released its associated sequence.

normalized_market_snapshot.payload_order: two descriptors, state records sorted by message_type, bid then ask levels, zero page padding

id_encoding.process_id: ASCII ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$, explicit byte length, bytes[96] zero-padded
id_encoding.target_host_id: ASCII ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$, explicit byte length, bytes[96] zero-padded
id_encoding.uuid: canonical HTTP UUID hex decoded left-to-right into 16 opaque bytes; never bytes_le

hash_semantics.global_config_hash: SHA256 of JCS complete normalized global config excluding materialization metadata
hash_semantics.projection_hash: SHA256 of JCS authorized projection payload
hash_semantics.projection_object_hash: SHA256 of exact delivered projection object bytes, excluding ResourceHeader and page padding
hash_semantics.control_commit_ref: SHA256 suffix of authenticated artifact:// commit-certificate reference
hash_semantics.receipt_hashes: SHA256 of immutable receipt object bytes; authenticated issuer provenance mandatory; self locator URI is external

CONFIG_STATUS_succeeded.scope: entire immutable target set, projection fields zero

preconditions: Negotiated feature bit 5 is required before parsing configuration opcodes or ConfigProjection resources.
Authenticated actor kind and source instance/host/boot match the allowed role and registered target; body actor_kind cannot confer authority.
Commit certificate authenticates operation, config/base revisions and hashes, immutable target set, projection policy and classification.

Before first application, current runtime revision equals expected_runtime_revision from the committed target plan and config_revision is greater; retries consult persisted operation result before revision checks.
A RollingRestart successor requires the exact SuccessorBound proof; unplanned instance/boot/generation changes reject.
NoOpRevisionAdvance still persists runtime and file receipts for the new global revision.
Only controller may finalize Succeeded after every fixed target has verified runtime, effective-file and journal receipts at its expected projection.

config_status_reply.error_status: matches body.status_reason; config_status Failed or Stalled

configuration_control.finalization_receipt: Committed completion certificate binds all target receipts and expected projections, plus OperationSucceeded control-journal proof.

exact_market_events.decimal_encoding: signed two-complement little-endian coefficient bytes[16], exponent i8, reserved zero[7]

market_transition_control.expected_cut_digest: approved complete MD Plan SHA-256; not a market cursor
market_transition_control.authorization: Authenticated existing Host report session after trusted operation approval; object validity alone grants no authority.
market_transition_control.rejection: Kind6/7 permit REPLAY_APPLIED flags18 with status1..3; body echoes exact request, no Armed/Activated object. Kind8 uses the separate capture_seal_control contract.

capture_seal_control.operation_id: capture ID, fixed before starting the capture process
capture_seal_control.expected_sequence: exact complete account prefix position at seal
capture_seal_control.authorization: Existing authenticated Host report session and actual owned Registry child. Captured input facts grant neither READY nor trading authority.

rebuild_install_control.operation_id: fixed schema4 Operation ID after input capture seal
rebuild_install_control.expected_sequence: exact captured warm row count, never reset to zero
rebuild_install_control.authorization: Existing authenticated Host report session and same owned Registry child. Installation binds the real preserved engine and durable history; Commit/Release and execution policy remain required.

rebuild_rollback_control.operation_id: fixed schema4 Operation ID after input capture seal
rebuild_rollback_control.expected_sequence: zero; no input cut advance is asserted
rebuild_rollback_control.authorization: Existing authenticated Host report session and same owned Registry child. Rollback completion binds the original Installation and actual independently executed probe. New READY follows synchronized closure installation; execution policy remains required.
